title: Haut Saus Wallet
tagline: ERC4337 compliant smart wallet with recoverability using an anonymous guardian
description: Traditional smart wallets often lack robust solutions for user recovery and secure cross-chain interactions, hindering the seamless utilization of decentralized assets. The Haut Saus Wallet addresses these challenges by introducing an ERC4337 compliant smart wallet with a unique focus on recoverability. Users frequently face the risk of losing access to their wallets due to forgotten passwords or compromised credentials, resulting in the permanent loss of valuable assets. Haut Saus Wallet mitigates this concern by implementing a novel recoverability feature through an anonymous guardian, providing a secure and user-friendly process for regaining control of assets in the event of an emergency. By combining recoverability, Haut Saus Wallet not only enhances the security of decentralized assets but also streamlines interactions in the decentralized landscape, offering users a versatile and robust smart wallet solution.
